pages.title: A museum ticket
lines: A little museum ticket glows in Gail's room. Colored flecks drift from it.
pages.translation: 小小的博物館票券在瑜瑜房裡發光。彩色紙屑飄出來。

pages.title: Paper doorway
lines: The colored flecks open a doorway. Gail sees a museum beyond it.
pages.translation: 彩色紙屑打開一道門。瑜瑜看見博物館。

pages.title: Many exhibits
lines: Gail sees fossils, statues, and picture labels. A curator waves hello.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看見化石、雕像和圖像標籤。管理員揮手。

pages.title: Labels fly
lines: A magical breeze lifts the picture labels. They land under the wrong exhibits.
pages.translation: 魔法風捲起圖像標籤，它們落在錯誤展品下。

pages.title: A mixed-up room
lines: A fossil has a statue label. The curator asks Gail to help.
pages.translation: 化石旁有雕像標籤。管理員請瑜瑜幫忙。

pages.title: Look before moving
lines: Gail does not move every label at once. She looks at one object first.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜沒有一下移動所有標籤。她先看一件物品。

pages.title: Rough and smooth
lines: Gail feels a safe sample. One surface is rough and another is smooth.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜摸安全樣本。一種表面粗糙，另一種光滑。

pages.title: Wood and metal
lines: Gail groups a wooden frame and a metal tool. They belong in different groups.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把木框與金屬工具分組。它們屬於不同組。

pages.title: The fossil shell
lines: Gail spots a spiral in a fossil. A picture card shows the same spiral.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看見化石的螺旋紋，一張圖卡也有同樣圖案。

pages.title: A footprint
lines: Gail finds a footprint pressed into stone. It is not the same as a loose bone.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜找到留在石頭上的腳印。它和骨頭不同。

pages.title: Two close pictures
lines: Two cards look similar. Gail compares the shape inside each frame.
pages.translation: 兩張卡片看起來相近。瑜瑜比較其中的形狀。

pages.title: The statue's base
lines: Gail finds a statue with a square base. Its picture card shows the same base.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜找到有方形底座的雕像。圖卡也畫了同樣底座。

pages.title: One unknown object
lines: One object does not fit any card. Gail sets it aside to ask about it.
pages.translation: 一件物品對不上任何圖卡。瑜瑜先放著，再詢問。

pages.title: The record drawer
lines: The curator opens a record drawer. Old picture cards are inside.
pages.translation: 管理員打開紀錄抽屜，裡面有舊圖卡。

pages.title: Find the drawing
lines: Gail finds a drawing of the round object. The curator checks it too.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜找到未知物的圖。管理員也核對。

pages.title: Put labels back
lines: Gail and the curator return the checked picture labels to the right displays.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和管理員把核對過的標籤放回正確展品旁。

pages.title: An orderly gallery
lines: The museum display is clear again. Visitors can see what each object is.
pages.translation: 博物館展覽又清楚了。訪客能看懂每件物品。

pages.title: How we knew
lines: Gail explains how she used shape and material. The curator thanks her.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜說明如何看形狀和材質。管理員謝謝她。

pages.title: The ticket returns
lines: The ticket lifts from Gail's hand. Colored flecks show her the way home.
pages.translation: 票券從瑜瑜手中升起。彩色紙屑帶她回家。

pages.title: Back in her room
lines: Gail keeps the ticket by her bed. She remembers to ask when she is unsure.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把票券放在床邊。她記得不確定時要提問。

pages.title: A museum ticket
lines: A little museum ticket rises beside Gail in her familiar bedroom. Colored flecks lift from its edge and gather near the window.
pages.translation: 一張小小的博物館票券在瑜瑜熟悉的臥室裡升起。彩色紙屑從票邊飄出，在窗邊聚集。

pages.title: Paper doorway
lines: Only after the ticket begins to glow do its paper flecks form a doorway. Gail sees a warm museum gallery on the other side.
pages.translation: 票券先發光，彩色紙屑才組成一道門。瑜瑜從門的另一端看見溫暖的博物館展廳。

pages.title: Many exhibits
lines: Gail enters a gallery filled with fossils, statues, and other exhibits. The friendly curator is preparing a new display.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜走進擺滿化石、雕像與其他展品的展廳。親切的管理員正在準備新展覽。

pages.title: Labels fly
lines: A brief magical breeze lifts the picture labels from their places. When they land, the labels no longer match the exhibits above them.
pages.translation: 一陣短短的魔法風把圖像標籤吹離原位。它們落下時，已和上方展品對不上了。

pages.title: A mixed-up room
lines: A fossil now has the picture label for a statue, while a smooth wooden object has a fossil label. The curator asks Gail to help sort them.
pages.translation: 化石旁貼著雕像圖卡，光滑的木製品旁卻貼著化石圖卡。管理員請瑜瑜幫忙整理。

pages.title: Look before moving
lines: Gail resists swapping labels at random. She and the curator inspect one exhibit before deciding which picture belongs beside it.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜沒有隨意交換標籤。她和管理員先仔細觀察一件展品，再決定哪張圖該放在旁邊。

pages.title: Rough and smooth
lines: The curator offers safe touch samples. Gail compares a rough stone surface with a smooth carved surface and notices they are not the same material.
pages.translation: 管理員提供可安全觸摸的樣本。瑜瑜比較粗糙石面與光滑雕刻面，發現兩者材質不同。

pages.title: Wood and metal
lines: Gail helps group a wooden frame with other wooden objects and a small metal tool with metal ones. Each material category narrows the possible labels.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把木框放在其他木製品旁，把小金屬工具放在金屬品旁。每個材質類別都縮小了標籤的可能範圍。

pages.title: The fossil shell
lines: Gail inspects a fossil with a clear spiral shape. One picture card shows the same shape, but she leaves it beside the exhibit until the curator checks it.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜觀察一件有清楚螺旋紋的化石。一張圖卡畫著相同形狀，但她先放在展品旁，等管理員核對。

pages.title: A footprint
lines: Nearby, Gail finds a footprint preserved in stone. Although both exhibits come from long ago, a footprint is a trace, not a loose bone.
pages.translation: 附近有一個保存在石頭裡的腳印。雖然兩件展品都很古老，腳印是痕跡，不是一塊散落的骨頭。

pages.title: Two close pictures
lines: Two picture cards share the same color, but one shows the outline of a foot and the other a bone. Gail compares shapes rather than colors alone.
pages.translation: 兩張圖卡顏色相同，一張畫腳掌輪廓，另一張畫骨頭。瑜瑜比較形狀，沒有只憑顏色判斷。

pages.title: The statue's base
lines: The small statue stands on a square base that appears on one picture card. Gail pairs them, then asks the curator to confirm the match.
pages.translation: 小雕像立在方形底座上，其中一張圖卡也畫了同樣底座。瑜瑜先配對，再請管理員確認。

pages.title: One unknown object
lines: A round object fits none of the remaining pictures. Gail does not invent an answer; she keeps its place open and asks the curator what they can check.
pages.translation: 一件圓形物品和剩下的圖卡都不相符。瑜瑜沒有編出答案，而是保留空位，問管理員還能查什麼。

pages.title: The record drawer
lines: The curator opens a drawer of original exhibit records. Each record includes a simple drawing of an object and where it was displayed.
pages.translation: 管理員打開存放原始展品紀錄的抽屜。每張紀錄都有物品簡圖與原先展示位置。

pages.title: Find the drawing
lines: Gail finds a drawing whose handle and round top match the unknown object. The curator checks both details before naming it.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜找到一張畫，畫上的把手和圓頂都與未知物相符。管理員核對兩處細節後，才說出物品名稱。

pages.title: Put labels back
lines: Together they return only the confirmed picture labels to their exhibits. The unknown object's label is added after its record has been checked.
pages.translation: 兩人只把確認過的圖像標籤放回展品旁。未知物的紀錄查清楚後，才補上它的標籤。

pages.title: An orderly gallery
lines: With each label beside the right exhibit, the gallery is easy to explore again. Visitors can compare the fossil, statue, and materials without confusion.
pages.translation: 每張標籤都回到正確展品旁，展廳又容易參觀了。訪客能清楚比較化石、雕像與各種材質。

pages.title: How we knew
lines: Gail tells the curator how shape, material, and the original records helped identify the objects. The curator thanks her for checking rather than guessing.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜告訴管理員，她如何用形狀、材質與原始紀錄辨認物品。管理員謝謝她先查證、沒有亂猜。

pages.title: The ticket returns
lines: After they say goodbye, the museum ticket glows again. Its colored flecks gather into a quiet doorway back to Gail's room.
pages.translation: 兩人道別後，博物館票券再次發光。彩色紙屑聚成一道安靜的門，通往瑜瑜的房間。

pages.title: Back in her room
lines: Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail places the ticket beside her bed. She remembers that an unanswered question can stay open until she finds good evidence.
pages.translation: 回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把票券放在床邊。她記得，沒有答案的問題可以先保留，找到可靠線索再回答。
